_readme: Spoken lines that are not found by walking the game data (collectSpokenLines): correria and bout feedback, conta stamps, anything captured in play. Add {speaker,text}; then run pnpm tts. In a dev build, window.ttsMissing() prints the lines that fell back to the system voice in this session, ready to paste here.
